name: Gold Coast Colony, counted subtotal
locator: Printed p. 71, Gold Coast census date. Printed p. 144, section 17, table 2, Total.
definition: Counted persons in the twelve districts of the Gold Coast Colony, excluding Ashanti and the Northern Territories. Nested within the broader three-part counted subtotal of 1,338,433. The estimated omission allowance of 148,000 has no district allocation. The figure does not represent the whole WWO polity cshapes_gw_452.

name: Gold Coast Colony and Ashanti, as stated in the annual report
method: official annual return with conflicting scope attribution
definition: The annual return states that 1,486,433 excludes the Northern Territories. The empire census table uses the same total after including Northern Territories 107,432 within a three-part count of 1,338,433 and adding an estimated 148,000 omissions. These publications do not establish two independently usable estimates. The imperial total and component counts already appear in collections/eastern.
